# MatGUI

`matgui.min.js` and `matgui.min.css` are the browser build of
[MatGUI](https://github.com/Matdata-eu/MatGUI) (`@matdata/yasgui` 6.6.0 on npm),
Matdata's fork of YASGUI. Font and image references in the stylesheet are
inlined as `data:` URIs so the viewer and its standalone HTML export work
offline.
